items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Rudy Van Gelder in the context of being a 'jazz advocate' and 'recording engineer', but the interviewee (Jimmy Owens) does not mention him, respond to his name, or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the recording engineer who did all the Blue Note records. Kennith Kimery: Rudy Van Gelder

Rudy Van Gelder, thank you so much. You know other people have been placed in that category of jazz advocates, but you are the first jazz musician to be in that category of both NEA Jazz Master musician and jazz advocate. So, so say whatever you would really like to say about this.
